module "I_HelperInlined.dss"

product 0 Material "M_HelperInlined" backend=Graph
  %0 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(2), ParameterName="Gain", SortPriority=0) : float @L4:C1 "Gain"
  %1 = Constant(Value=(3)) : float @L19:C27 "A"
  %2 = Multiply(%0, %1) : float @L8:C12 via L19:C15 "A"
  %3 = Constant(Value=(0.5)) : float @L13:C16 via L22:C5 "Half"
  %4 = Multiply(%2, %3) : float @L13:C12 via L22:C5 "Half"
  %5 = Constant(Value=(2)) : float @L14:C18 via L22:C5 "Double"
  %6 = Multiply(%2, %5) : float @L14:C14 via L22:C5 "Double"
  %7 = Add(%4, %6) : float @L23:C17 "Opacity"
  %8 = MaterialSink(Opacity=%7) @L17:C1
  sink %8
